speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs how the Government is and will be engaging different groups when considering the best way forward on section 377A of the Penal Code.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: There are, currently, two main viewpoints on this issue and many subsidiary viewpoints.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: As I said in Parliament, there are two main viewpoints.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Ms Hazel Poa or Mr Leong Mun Wai?

speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
text: As the Minister has pointed out, there are two different camps with different views on this particular issue.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: There are many different ways of saying "I don't know", so I assume that Ms Poa is saying either the Party has no position or they do not know what their position is.
